# Corporate Games

> Online games for company events, for the people you invite. Corporate game software for HR teams: Tambola (Housie), Bingo, Tic Tac Toe, Snakes and Ladders and Luck by Chance. Players open a link on their phone, with no app. Players never pay. A free demo for 10 people is available. Run in India by IT Services by Rajat Agarwal.

Corporate Games is the home page for a family of game sites. All six games start from one console, and Lucky Draw is available now. The full text of the main pages is in https://home.corporatetambola.com/llms-full.txt.

## Pages
- [Home](https://home.corporatetambola.com/): online games for company events, with a short FAQ
- [The games](https://home.corporatetambola.com/games): corporate game software, the six games
- [Virtual team building games](https://home.corporatetambola.com/virtual-team-building-games): for remote and hybrid teams in India
- [Games for HR teams](https://home.corporatetambola.com/games-for-hr-teams): how an HR team plans a game day
- [For HR teams](https://home.corporatetambola.com/for-hr): employee engagement games, what you decide
- [How it works](https://home.corporatetambola.com/how-it-works): choose a game, invite your people, play together
- [Pricing](https://home.corporatetambola.com/pricing): you pay once for each game you run, through Razorpay
- [Privacy and Data](https://home.corporatetambola.com/privacy): what is auto-deleted and when
- [Contact](https://home.corporatetambola.com/contact): e-mail and phone

## The games
- [Corporate Tambola](https://console.corporatetambola.com/#/create): The classic number game, also called Housie.
- [Corporate Bingo](https://console.corporatetambola.com/#/create): Numbers are called out loud and every player gets a card on their phone.
- [Corporate Tic Tac Toe](https://console.corporatetambola.com/#/create): A one-against-one tournament for your whole company.
- [Corporate Snakes and Ladders](https://console.corporatetambola.com/#/create): Everyone gets their own board and plays at the same time.
- [Corporate Luck by Chance](https://console.corporatetambola.com/#/create): A dice game of pure luck with a clock on every round.

## Facts
- Players open a link in their phone browser. No app and no password.
- Players never pay. The organizer gives the prizes.
- Building a game is free. You pay once for each game you run, before it starts. No yearly plan.
- The only payee is IT Services by Rajat Agarwal, through Razorpay.
- No personal details needed. All participant information is deleted within 24 hours of the game.
